critical_limits: All COMs in the window are above the lowest rim: original mean-fan membership is not a cap-independent physical containment certificate. Mean/high caps agree for COM at42.665 but190node memberships differ.

reviewable_control_conditions: Retain the original full-depth hypothetical capacity/route preflight and every original material/table/robot/force/torque gate; declare the new shorter executed endpoint separately.
Reach the shorter endpoint with the same continuous rate limits and zero endpoint velocity; preserve left-held handle and original right grasp requirements until an explicit release decision.

Use a fresh actual stopped observation, valid originalcap and finite exactCOM/node metrics; require the declared partial-release condition instead of automatically releasing on height or elapsedtime. Observe temporal motion rather than claiming a single partial-inside result demonstrates support.
If pre-release grip/contact/material gates fail, stop under the existing policy; do not relabel an involuntary lost grip as intentional release.
After a deliberate smooth release, gravity seating/withdrawal/retention still require native physics and unchanged final ALL-node plus COMcontainment and retention acceptance.
